passages.text: Strobilanthes crispa is a shrub which originated from Madagascar, and is now found across south east Asia. It is a member of the family Acanthaceae. It is known as {{lang|zsm|pokok pecah kaca}} or {{lang|zsm|pokok pecah beling}} in Malaysia, and {{lang|id|pecah beling}}, {{lang|id|enyoh kilo}}, {{lang|id|kecibeling}} or {{lang|id|kejibeling}} in Indonesia.{{Citation needed|date=February 2018}} The leaves are used traditionally for treatment of cancer and diabetes, usually taken as a tea or infusion of the leaves.
